title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
summary: 從電子波長與作用體積出發，把 Schottky 場發射源亮度、繞射、球面與色像差合成探針直徑，理解 Everhart–Thornley 偵測器與 Rose 判準如何決定停留時間，再把充電、EDS 激發體積、雜散磁場與驗收測試整合成可交付的掃描電子顯微鏡工程。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 成像條件設計練習：在碳膜上拍 20 nm 金顆粒，Schottky 源、5 kV、I_p = 50 pA、α = 5 mrad、C_s = C_c = 2 mm、ΔE = 0.7 eV、β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹。λ = 17.3 pm；d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm；d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm；d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm；d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm；d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm，對 20 nm 顆粒足夠。像素取 1.5 nm → 1024 像素掃描寬 1.54 µm。對比 C = 10%、δ = 0.3、收集效率 0.5：每像素需 2500 個偵測電子，停留 53 µs，單幀 56 s。若漂移 1 nm/min，拖影 0.93 nm；改成 8 幀各 7 s 對齊疊加，單幀拖影 0.12 nm。要用 EDS 確認顆粒是金，20 kV 的 Au Mα 激發體積約 1 µm，顆粒訊號被稀釋百倍以上，所以改用 5 kV 的 Au Mα（2.12 keV，過電壓比 2.4）並接受更長的計數時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Imaging-condition exercise: image 20 nm gold particles on carbon with a Schottky source at 5 kV, I_p = 50 pA, α = 5 mrad, C_s = C_c = 2 mm, ΔE = 0.7 eV, β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹. λ = 17.3 pm; d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm; d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm; d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm; d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm; d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm, adequate for 20 nm particles. Choose 1.5 nm pixels → 1024 pixels span 1.54 µm. With contrast C = 10%, δ = 0.3 and collection efficiency 0.5, each pixel needs 2500 detected electrons, a 53 µs dwell and a 56 s frame. With 1 nm/min drift the smear is 0.93 nm; switching to 8 aligned frames of 7 s each cuts the per-frame smear to 0.12 nm. To confirm the particles are gold by EDS, the Au Mα excitation volume at 20 kV is about 1 µm and the particle signal is diluted more than a hundredfold, so use Au Mα at 5 kV (2.12 keV, overvoltage ratio 2.4) and accept longer counting. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電子波長、作用體積與影像來源」與「探針直徑：亮度、繞射、球面與色像差」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin" and "Probe diameter: brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic terms": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電子波長、作用體積與影像來源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電子束、作用體積與訊號」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描電子顯微鏡不成像於透鏡，而是把聚焦電子探針以光柵方式掃過樣品，逐點收集訊號強度後以同樣的掃描順序畫成影像；放大率只是掃描寬度與顯示寬度之比。電子在 1 到 30 kV 的波長為皮米等級，所以解析度不受繞射限制而受探針大小與作用體積限制。入射電子在樣品內散射成梨形的作用體積，二次電子（< 50 eV）只能從表面幾奈米逸出，帶表面形貌資訊；背向散射電子來自更深處，產率隨原子序上升，帶成分對比；特徵 X 光來自整個激發體積，用於成分分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A scanning electron microscope does not form an image with lenses; it rasters a focused electron probe over the specimen, collects a signal intensity point by point and paints the image in the same scan order, so magnification is merely the ratio of display width to scan width. Electron wavelengths at 1 to 30 kV are picometres, so resolution is limited not by diffraction but by probe size and interaction volume. Incident electrons scatter into a pear-shaped interaction volume: secondary electrons (< 50 eV) escape only from the top few nanometres and carry topography; backscattered electrons come from deeper and their yield rises with atomic number, carrying composition contrast; characteristic X-rays come from the whole excited volume and serve composition analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對論電子波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：1 kV 時 38.8 pm，5 kV 時 17.3 pm，30 kV 時 7.0 pm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relativistic electron wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 38.8 pm at 1 kV, 17.3 pm at 5 kV, 7.0 pm at 30 kV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子波長只有皮米，所以掃描電子顯微鏡的解析度也接近皮米。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the electron wavelength is picometres, SEM resolution is also near a picometre." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 電子波長、作用體積與影像來源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對論電子波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：1 kV 時 38.8 pm，5 kV 時 17.3 pm，30 kV 時 7.0 pm。Kanaya–Okayama 作用深度 R = 0.0276·A·E^1.67/(Z^0.889·ρ) µm（E 以 keV 計）：矽（A = 28.09、Z = 14、ρ = 2.33 g/cm³）在 1 kV 為 0.032 µm、5 kV 為 0.47 µm、20 kV 為 4.7 µm；金在 20 kV 只有 0.86 µm。降低加速電壓是把訊號限制在表面附近的主要手段。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relativistic electron wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 38.8 pm at 1 kV, 17.3 pm at 5 kV, 7.0 pm at 30 kV. Kanaya–Okayama range R = 0.0276·A·E^1.67/(Z^0.889·ρ) µm with E in keV: silicon (A = 28.09, Z = 14, ρ = 2.33 g/cm³) gives 0.032 µm at 1 kV, 0.47 µm at 5 kV and 4.7 µm at 20 kV; gold at 20 kV only 0.86 µm. Lowering the accelerating voltage is the main way to confine the signal near the surface. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在矽基板上鍍 100 nm 的鋁圖案，分別以 2、5、20 kV 拍二次電子與背向散射電子影像：20 kV 時圖案邊緣因深層散射而模糊、基板資訊透出，2 kV 時邊緣銳利；以 Monte Carlo 模擬（例如 CASINO）算出的作用體積與 Kanaya–Okayama 估計及影像觀察比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pattern 100 nm of aluminium on silicon and record secondary- and backscattered-electron images at 2, 5 and 20 kV: at 20 kV the edges blur through deep scattering and substrate information bleeds through, at 2 kV the edges are sharp; compare the interaction volumes from a Monte Carlo simulation such as CASINO with the Kanaya–Okayama estimate and with what the images show.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Relativistic electron wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 38.8 pm at 1 kV, 17.3 pm at 5 kV, 7.0 pm at 30 kV. Kanaya–Okayama range R = 0.0276·A·E^1.67/(Z^0.889·ρ) µm with E in keV: silicon (A = 28.09, Z = 14, ρ = 2.33 g/cm³) gives 0.032 µm at 1 kV, 0.47 µm at 5 kV and 4.7 µm at 20 kV; gold at 20 kV only 0.86 µm. steps.title: 電子波長、作用體積與影像來源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電子束、作用體積與訊號」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在矽基板上鍍 100 nm 的鋁圖案，分別以 2、5、20 kV 拍二次電子與背向散射電子影像：20 kV 時圖案邊緣因深層散射而模糊、基板資訊透出，2 kV 時邊緣銳利；以 Monte Carlo 模擬（例如 CASINO）算出的作用體積與 Kanaya–Okayama 估計及影像觀察比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pattern 100 nm of aluminium on silicon and record secondary- and backscattered-electron images at 2, 5 and 20 kV: at 20 kV the edges blur through deep scattering and substrate information bleeds through, at 2 kV the edges are sharp; compare the interaction volumes from a Monte Carlo simulation such as CASINO with the Kanaya–Okayama estimate and with what the images show. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 20 kV 量 50 nm 厚塗層的表面顆粒，背向散射電子來自塗層下方的基板，顆粒對比被基板訊號淹沒，誤判為塗層平整；同一樣品在 2 kV 下顆粒清楚可見。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Imaging particles on a 50 nm coating at 20 kV lets backscattered electrons from the substrate beneath swamp the particle contrast, so the coating is wrongly judged smooth; at 2 kV the same particles are clearly visible.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在矽基板上鍍 100 nm 的鋁圖案，分別以 2、5、20 kV 拍二次電子與背向散射電子影像：20 kV 時圖案邊緣因深層散射而模糊、基板資訊透出，2 kV 時邊緣銳利；以 Monte Carlo 模擬（例如 CASINO）算出的作用體積與 Kanaya–Okayama 估計及影像觀察比較。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電子波長、作用體積與影像來源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin"?
options: 在矽基板上鍍 100 nm 的鋁圖案，分別以 2、5、20 kV 拍二次電子與背向散射電子影像：20 kV 時圖案邊緣因深層散射而模糊、基板資訊透出，2 kV 時邊緣銳利。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鏡筒是金屬做的，所以外部磁場進不去。
optionsEn: Pattern 100 nm of aluminium on silicon and record secondary- and backscattered-electron images at 2, 5 and 20 kV: at 20 kV the edges blur through deep scattering and substrate information bleeds through, at 2 kV the edges are sharp.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.titleEn: Probe diameter: brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic terms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「探針直徑預算表」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Probe-diameter budget table” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 探針是電子源經聚光鏡與物鏡縮小後的像，直徑由四項以均方根合成：源的幾何縮小像 d_g 由亮度 β、探針電流 I_p 與會聚半角 α 決定，電流越大、角度越小則越大；繞射項 d_d = 0.61λ/α 隨角度變小而變大；球面像差 d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³ 隨角度三次方增長；色像差 d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α 在低加速電壓時因 ΔE/E 變大而主導。工程上以終端光圈選 α，在繞射與球面項之間取最佳值，而低電壓下的色像差只能靠低能量散佈的源、減速或單色器壓低。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針直徑預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The probe is the demagnified image of the source formed by condenser and objective lenses, and its diameter combines four terms in quadrature: the geometric source image d_g set by brightness β, probe current I_p and convergence semi-angle α, growing with current and shrinking angle; diffraction d_d = 0.61λ/α, growing as the angle shrinks; spherical aberration d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³, growing with the cube of angle; and chromatic aberration d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α, dominant at low voltage because ΔE/E grows. The final aperture chooses α to balance diffraction against the spherical term, while low-voltage chromatic blur can only be reduced by a low-energy-spread source, beam deceleration or a monochromator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Probe-diameter budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c²，d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c² with d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光圈越小探針越細，所以永遠應該用最小光圈。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smaller aperture always gives a finer probe, so the smallest aperture should always be used." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「探針直徑預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 探針直徑：亮度、繞射、球面與色像差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Probe diameter: brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic terms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探針直徑預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Probe-diameter budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c²，d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。教學假設 Schottky 源、I_p = 50 pA、α = 5 mrad、C_s = C_c = 2 mm、ΔE = 0.7 eV。5 kV（β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹、λ = 17.3 pm）：d_g = 2.0 nm、d_d = 2.1 nm、d_s = 0.13 nm、d_c = 1.4 nm，d_p ≈ 3.2 nm。1 kV（β = 4×10¹⁰）：d_g = 4.5、d_d = 4.7、d_c = 7.0 nm，d_p ≈ 9.6 nm，色像差主導；若改用 ΔE = 0.3 eV 的冷場發射源且亮度維持 2×10¹¹，1 kV 探針縮到約 6 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c² with d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β). Teaching assumptions: Schottky source, I_p = 50 pA, α = 5 mrad, C_s = C_c = 2 mm, ΔE = 0.7 eV. At 5 kV (β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹, λ = 17.3 pm): d_g = 2.0 nm, d_d = 2.1 nm, d_s = 0.13 nm, d_c = 1.4 nm, d_p ≈ 3.2 nm. At 1 kV (β = 4×10¹⁰): d_g = 4.5, d_d = 4.7, d_c = 7.0 nm, d_p ≈ 9.6 nm, chromatic dominated; a cold field emitter with ΔE = 0.3 eV at the same 2×10¹¹ brightness shrinks the 1 kV probe to about 6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在碳膜上的金顆粒樣品量影像解析度（最小可分辨間隙或傅立葉環相關）作為探針直徑的上界，分別換 20、30、50 µm 光圈改變 α，畫出解析度對 α 的曲線，最佳點應落在 (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad 附近；再把探針電流從 10 pA 增到 1 nA，確認解析度依 √I_p 的趨勢變差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure image resolution on gold-on-carbon (smallest resolvable gap or Fourier ring correlation) as an upper bound of probe diameter, swap 20, 30 and 50 µm apertures to vary α and plot resolution against α, whose optimum should lie near (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad; then raise probe current from 10 pA to 1 nA and confirm resolution degrades with the √I_p trend.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 探針直徑：亮度、繞射、球面與色像差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Probe diameter: brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic terms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「探針直徑預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Probe-diameter budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在碳膜上的金顆粒樣品量影像解析度（最小可分辨間隙或傅立葉環相關）作為探針直徑的上界，分別換 20、30、50 µm 光圈改變 α，畫出解析度對 α 的曲線，最佳點應落在 (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad 附近；再把探針電流從 10 pA 增到 1 nA，確認解析度依 √I_p 的趨勢變差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure image resolution on gold-on-carbon (smallest resolvable gap or Fourier ring correlation) as an upper bound of probe diameter, swap 20, 30 and 50 µm apertures to vary α and plot resolution against α, whose optimum should lie near (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad; then raise probe current from 10 pA to 1 nA and confirm resolution degrades with the √I_p trend. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了做 EDS 把探針電流調到 2 nA 後直接拍高倍影像，d_g 放大六倍以上，探針從 3 nm 變成十幾奈米，操作者以為是對焦或像散沒調好而反覆調整，實際是亮度預算用完了。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising probe current to 2 nA for EDS and then taking high-magnification images inflates d_g more than sixfold, the probe grows from 3 nm to over ten, and the operator keeps readjusting focus and stigmation while the real cause is an exhausted brightness budget.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 為了做 EDS 把探針電流調到 2 nA 後直接拍高倍影像，d_g 放大六倍以上，探針從 3 nm 變成十幾奈米，操作者以為是對焦或像散沒調好而反覆調整，實際是亮度預算用完了。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 電子源：鎢絲、LaB₆、Schottky 與冷場發射：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron sources: tungsten, LaB₆, Schottky and cold field emission: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子源決定亮度、能量散佈、穩定度與真空需求。鎢絲熱發射在 2800 K 工作，亮度約 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、能量散佈 2 到 3 eV，便宜但探針粗；LaB₆ 亮度高一個數量級。Schottky 發射器是 ZrO 覆蓋的鎢 ⟨100⟩ 尖端，在約 1800 K 與強電場下工作，亮度約 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、散佈 0.6 到 0.9 eV、虛擬源約 20 nm、電流穩定且壽命超過一年，需要 10⁻⁷ Pa 等級的槍室真空。冷場發射在室溫以純場發射工作，散佈 0.3 eV、亮度更高、虛擬源約 5 nm，但需要 10⁻⁸ Pa 以下的真空並定期加熱清除吸附氣體以恢復電流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The source sets brightness, energy spread, stability and vacuum demand. A tungsten hairpin emits thermionically at 2800 K with about 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹ and 2 to 3 eV spread, cheap but coarse; LaB₆ is an order of magnitude brighter. A Schottky emitter is a ZrO-coated tungsten ⟨100⟩ tip at about 1800 K under a strong field, giving about 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹, 0.6 to 0.9 eV spread, a roughly 20 nm virtual source, stable current and a lifetime over a year, and it needs a gun vacuum near 10⁻⁷ Pa. A cold field emitter works at room temperature by pure field emission with 0.3 eV spread, higher brightness and a 5 nm virtual source, but needs below 10⁻⁸ Pa and periodic flashing to desorb gas and restore current. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：亮度把電流換成探針大小：d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Brightness converts current into probe size through d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「場發射源的亮度高，所以任何電流下探針都比鎢絲細。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A field-emission source is brighter, so its probe is finer at every current than a tungsten hairpin's." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 電子源：鎢絲、LaB₆、Schottky 與冷場發射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron sources: tungsten, LaB₆, Schottky and cold field emission: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：亮度把電流換成探針大小：d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。同樣 α = 5 mrad、I_p = 50 pA，β 從鎢絲的 10⁹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹ 提升到 Schottky 的 2×10¹¹ 時，d_g 由 28 nm 降到 2.0 nm（√200 ≈ 14 倍）。色像差正比於 ΔE：在 1 kV、C_c = 2 mm、α = 5 mrad 下，ΔE = 2.5 eV 的鎢絲給 d_c = 25 nm，Schottky 0.7 eV 給 7 nm，冷場 0.3 eV 給 3 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Brightness converts current into probe size through d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β). At the same α = 5 mrad and I_p = 50 pA, raising β from a tungsten hairpin's 10⁹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹ to a Schottky emitter's 2×10¹¹ shrinks d_g from 28 nm to 2.0 nm (√200 ≈ 14 times). Chromatic blur scales with ΔE: at 1 kV with C_c = 2 mm and α = 5 mrad, a 2.5 eV tungsten spread gives d_c = 25 nm, Schottky 0.7 eV gives 7 nm and cold field emission 0.3 eV gives 3 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以法拉第杯量探針電流並記錄 8 小時的漂移，Schottky 源應在 1% 內、冷場源在閃熱後呈指數衰減；用槍室的離子泵電流讀真空並確認在 10⁻⁷ Pa 以下；能量散佈以能量分析器或由低電壓解析度隨 ΔE 的變化間接驗證；記錄抽取電壓與加熱電流的操作點，與原廠交付值比較以判斷尖端老化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure probe current in a Faraday cup and log 8 hours of drift, expecting a Schottky source within 1% and a cold emitter to decay exponentially after flashing; read gun vacuum from the ion-pump current and confirm it is below 10⁻⁷ Pa; verify energy spread with an energy analyser or indirectly through low-voltage resolution versus ΔE; record extractor voltage and heating current and compare with factory values to judge tip ageing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 放大率校正、像素取樣與解析度量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnification calibration, pixel sampling and resolution measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「節距標準片與像素尺度」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pitch standard and pixel scale” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影像上的長度由掃描線圈的電流對樣品面位移的比例決定，這個比例隨加速電壓、工作距離與線圈溫度變化，所以每個條件都要用節距已知且可溯源的光柵標準片校正；像素尺寸 = 掃描寬度/像素數，必須小於探針直徑的一半才算有效取樣，再放大只是「空放大」。解析度不應只看規格表，要用金顆粒碳膜樣品量最小可分辨間隙，或用兩張獨立影像的傅立葉環相關求出資訊極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「節距標準片與像素尺度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3.2 nm probe needs pixels ≤ 1.5 nm: 1024 pixels then span 1.54 µm, about 195,000× on a 300 mm display, and more magnification only enlarges pixels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「顯示的放大率數字就是校正過的尺度，與工作條件無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 放大率校正、像素取樣與解析度量測：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節距標準片與像素尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pitch standard and pixel scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.2 nm 探針需要 ≤ 1.5 nm 像素：1024 像素對應掃描寬度 1.54 µm，在 300 mm 顯示器上相當於約 195,000 倍；再往上放大只是放大像素。放大率校正：量 100 nm 節距光柵的 20 個週期得到 2.00 µm 與證書值比較，若讀值 2.04 µm 則比例誤差 2%，校正後殘餘由光柵證書（0.3%）與邊緣定位（0.2 像素）決定，約 0.5%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3.2 nm probe needs pixels ≤ 1.5 nm: 1024 pixels then span 1.54 µm, about 195,000× on a 300 mm display, and more magnification only enlarges pixels. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在常用的每組（電壓、工作距離、放大率）條件下量光柵標準片的 x 與 y 節距，紀錄比例因子與正交性誤差並建立校正表；用解析度樣品在 1、5、15 kV 各測一次最小間隙並存檔影像；每月重複，比例因子漂移超過 1% 即重新校正並追溯期間的量測結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each routinely used (voltage, working distance, magnification) set measure the grating pitch in x and y, log scale factor and orthogonality error into a calibration table; measure the smallest gap on the resolution specimen at 1, 5 and 15 kV and archive the images; repeat monthly, and when the scale factor drifts beyond 1% recalibrate and review measurements from the interval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.objective: 說明「充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Charging crossover and EDS excitation volume” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 絕緣樣品的總產率 σ = δ + η 隨能量變化，在第二交叉點 E₂（多數氧化物與高分子約 1 到 3 kV）等於 1；高於 E₂ 時電子淨流入、表面帶負電，影像變亮、漂移、甚至把入射束偏轉；低於 E₂ 時輕微帶正電而自限。對策是把電壓選在 E₂ 附近、鍍數奈米的導電膜、或用數十帕的低真空讓氣體離子中和表面。能量散佈 X 光譜（EDS）需要過電壓比 E₀/E_c ≥ 2 才有足夠激發，X 光來自整個激發體積，所以成分的空間解析度通常是微米等級，與影像的奈米解析度完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An insulator's total yield σ = δ + η varies with energy and equals 1 at the second crossover E₂, about 1 to 3 kV for most oxides and polymers; above E₂ electrons accumulate, the surface charges negative, the image brightens, drifts and can even deflect the incoming beam, while below E₂ mild positive charging is self-limiting. Remedies are choosing the voltage near E₂, coating a few nanometres of conductor, or low vacuum at tens of pascals so gas ions neutralise the surface. Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) needs an overvoltage ratio E₀/E_c ≥ 2 for efficient excitation, and X-rays come from the whole excited volume, so compositional spatial resolution is usually micrometres, unlike the nanometre resolution of the image. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Charging crossover and EDS excitation volume”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Castaing X 光產生深度 R_x ≈ 0.033·(E₀^1.7 − E_c^1.7)·A/(ρZ) µm：銅 Kα（E_c = 8.04 keV）在 20 kV 為 1.0 µm；矽 Kα（1.74 keV）在 20 kV 為 4.6 µm、在 5 kV 為 0.37 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Castaing X-ray generation range R_x ≈ 0.033·(E₀^1.7 − E_c^1.7)·A/(ρZ) µm: copper Kα (E_c = 8.04 keV) at 20 kV gives 1.0 µm; silicon Kα (1.74 keV) gives 4.6 µm at 20 kV and 0.37 µm at 5 kV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「EDS 成分圖的空間解析度和二次電子影像一樣是奈米級。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Charging crossover and EDS excitation volume” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在未鍍膜的氧化鋁或 PMMA 上從 0.5 kV 逐步升壓拍同一區域，找出影像由穩定轉為漂移發亮的電壓即 E₂；比較鍍 5 nm 鉑與低真空 50 Pa 兩種對策的影像穩定性與解析度損失；EDS 用純銅標準片在 20 kV 校正能量尺度（Kα 8.04 keV）與解析度（Mn Kα 處約 125 eV），並以多層標準片驗證激發深度估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On uncoated alumina or PMMA raise the voltage from 0.5 kV in steps while imaging the same area and find E₂ where the image turns from stable to drifting and bright; compare image stability and resolution loss for a 5 nm platinum coat versus 50 Pa low vacuum; calibrate EDS energy scale on pure copper at 20 kV (Kα 8.04 keV) and resolution (about 125 eV at Mn Kα), and verify the excitation-depth estimate on a multilayer standard. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了做 EDS 把高分子樣品調到 20 kV 而未鍍膜，表面累積負電把入射束偏開，影像拉伸、掃描框扭曲，EDS 圖譜中的位置對不上影像位置，整批定量結果作廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Running an uncoated polymer at 20 kV for EDS lets accumulated negative charge deflect the beam, the image stretches and the scan frame warps, EDS map positions no longer match the image and the whole batch of quantification is discarded.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 為了做 EDS 把高分子樣品調到 20 kV 而未鍍膜，表面累積負電把入射束偏開，影像拉伸、掃描框扭曲，EDS 圖譜中的位置對不上影像位置，整批定量結果作廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Running an uncoated polymer at 20 kV for EDS lets accumulated negative charge deflect the beam, the image stretches and the scan frame warps, EDS map positions no longer match the image and the whole batch of quantification is discarded. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「場址整合：雜散磁場、振動與聲學」與「驗收、漂移與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Site integration: stray magnetic fields, vibration and acoustics" and "Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 場址整合：雜散磁場、振動與聲學：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Site integration: stray magnetic fields, vibration and acoustics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子束是帶電粒子，在物鏡與樣品之間的最後一段幾乎沒有屏蔽，環境的交流磁場會把探針以電源頻率左右搖擺，影像邊緣出現鋸齒；低電壓時電子動量小、偏轉更大。地板振動經由樣品台放大，使影像在掃描中錯位；聲音則直接搖動鏡筒。因此安裝前必須做場址調查，量 1 到 1000 Hz 的磁場、振動與聲壓，必要時加主動磁場消除器、主動隔振平台與隔音罩，並把顯微鏡遠離電梯、變壓器與空調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The electron beam is a charged particle and its final path between objective and specimen is almost unshielded, so ambient ac magnetic fields rock the probe at mains frequency and image edges turn jagged; at low voltage the electron momentum is smaller and the deflection larger. Floor vibration, amplified through the stage, displaces the image during the scan, and sound shakes the column directly. A site survey measuring 1 to 1000 Hz magnetic field, vibration and sound pressure therefore precedes installation, with active field cancellation, active isolation and acoustic enclosures added when needed, and the microscope kept away from lifts, transformers and air handlers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：磁場偏轉：半徑 r = p/(eB)，在長度 L 內的橫移 ≈ L²/(2r)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Field deflection: radius r = p/(eB), lateral shift over length L ≈ L²/(2r).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡筒是金屬做的，所以外部磁場進不去。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The column is metal, so external magnetic fields cannot get in." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「場址整合：雜散磁場、振動與聲學」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site integration: stray magnetic fields, vibration and acoustics" is correct?

驗收時影像夠清楚就代表所有條件下都達到規格。

steps.title: 場址整合：雜散磁場、振動與聲學：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site integration: stray magnetic fields, vibration and acoustics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：磁場偏轉：半徑 r = p/(eB)，在長度 L 內的橫移 ≈ L²/(2r)。1 kV 電子（p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s）在 B = 30 nT（0.3 mG）、L = 10 mm 的未屏蔽路徑上橫移 ≈ 14 nm；B = 300 nT 時 140 nm；15 kV 時同樣 30 nT 只有 3.6 nm。鏡筒末端若有 20 倍的屏蔽係數，1 kV 的 14 nm 降到 0.7 nm，這就是常見 0.3 mG 場址規格的來源。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Field deflection: radius r = p/(eB), lateral shift over length L ≈ L²/(2r). A 1 kV electron (p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s) in B = 30 nT (0.3 mG) over an unshielded L = 10 mm shifts ≈ 14 nm; at 300 nT, 140 nm; at 15 kV the same 30 nT gives only 3.6 nm. With a shielding factor of 20 at the column end the 1 kV figure drops to 0.7 nm, which is where the common 0.3 mG site specification comes from. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三軸磁通閘計量安裝點的 50/60 Hz 與直流磁場，以加速規量地板在 1 到 100 Hz 的速度譜，與原廠場址規格比較；安裝後在 1 kV 拍高倍影像並做傅立葉分析，影像中出現的電源頻率週期性鋸齒幅度可直接換算回殘餘磁場；開啟主動消磁後重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure 50/60 Hz and dc fields at the site with a three-axis fluxgate and floor velocity spectra from 1 to 100 Hz with an accelerometer, comparing with the vendor's site specification; after installation take a 1 kV high-magnification image and Fourier-analyse it, converting the amplitude of mains-frequency jaggedness back into residual field; re-measure with active cancellation on.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 磁場偏轉：半徑 r = p/(eB)，在長度 L 內的橫移 ≈ L²/(2r)。1 kV 電子（p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s）在 B = 30 nT（0.3 mG）、L = 10 mm 的未屏蔽路徑上橫移 ≈ 14 nm；B = 300 nT 時 140 nm；15 kV 時同樣 30 nT 只有 3.6 nm。鏡筒末端若有 20 倍的屏蔽係數，1 kV 的 14 nm 降到 0.7 nm，這就是常見 0.3 mG 場址規格的來源。
knowledge.textEn: Field deflection: radius r = p/(eB), lateral shift over length L ≈ L²/(2r). A 1 kV electron (p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s) in B = 30 nT (0.3 mG) over an unshielded L = 10 mm shifts ≈ 14 nm; at 300 nT, 140 nm; at 15 kV the same 30 nT gives only 3.6 nm. With a shielding factor of 20 at the column end the 1 kV figure drops to 0.7 nm, which is where the common 0.3 mG site specification comes from.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.instruction: 顯微鏡裝在配電室隔壁，60 Hz 磁場 2 mG 使 1 kV 影像邊緣出現 100 nm 的鋸齒，被誤認為樣品本身的粗糙；在 15 kV 下看似正常，於是低電壓表面影像能力整個被放棄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 驗收、漂移與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收測試與操作規範」如何決定掃描電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance tests and operating procedures” determines the key performance of “Scanning electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收不是看一張漂亮影像，而是在約定條件下重現可量化的指標：在指定電壓與工作距離量解析度樣品、以節距光柵量放大率、以法拉第杯量探針電流、以 EDS 標準片量能量解析度，並量影像漂移與樣品台重現性。漂移來自樣品台熱平衡、鏡筒熱膨脹與充電，在長停留時間的高解析度影像中會把探針的優勢抹掉。交接文件包含各條件的校正表、場址量測、每月維護項目（光圈清潔、尖端閃熱、法拉第杯校正）、以及針對絕緣與高分子樣品的操作規範。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試與操作規範」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is not one handsome image but reproducible, quantified indicators under agreed conditions: resolution on the standard specimen at specified voltage and working distance, magnification on a pitch grating, probe current in a Faraday cup, EDS energy resolution on a standard, plus image drift and stage repeatability. Drift arises from stage thermal settling, column expansion and charging, and in long-dwell high-resolution frames it erases the probe's advantage. The handoff package holds calibration tables per condition, site measurements, monthly maintenance items (aperture cleaning, tip flashing, Faraday-cup calibration) and operating procedures for insulating and polymer specimens. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance tests and operating procedures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：漂移預算：1 nm/min 的漂移在 56 s 的單幀內造成 0.93 nm 的拖影，對 3.2 nm 探針是 29% 的損失；要把拖影壓到探針的 10%（0.32 nm），漂移必須小於 0.34 nm/min，或改用 8 幀各 7 s 的快速掃描並以互相關對齊後疊加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Drift budget: 1 nm/min over a 56 s frame smears 0.93 nm, a 29% loss on a 3.2 nm probe; to hold the smear to 10% of the probe (0.32 nm) drift must stay below 0.34 nm/min, or use 8 fast frames of 7 s each aligned by cross-correlation and summed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「驗收時影像夠清楚就代表所有條件下都達到規格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A clear image at acceptance proves specification is met under all conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收測試與操作規範」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance tests and operating procedures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 驗收、漂移與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收測試與操作規範」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance tests and operating procedures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：漂移預算：1 nm/min 的漂移在 56 s 的單幀內造成 0.93 nm 的拖影，對 3.2 nm 探針是 29% 的損失；要把拖影壓到探針的 10%（0.32 nm），漂移必須小於 0.34 nm/min，或改用 8 幀各 7 s 的快速掃描並以互相關對齊後疊加。驗收指標範例：1 kV 解析度 ≤ 10 nm、5 kV ≤ 3.5 nm、放大率誤差 ≤ 1%、探針電流 8 h 穩定度 ≤ 2%、EDS Mn Kα 解析度 ≤ 130 eV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Drift budget: 1 nm/min over a 56 s frame smears 0.93 nm, a 29% loss on a 3.2 nm probe; to hold the smear to 10% of the probe (0.32 nm) drift must stay below 0.34 nm/min, or use 8 fast frames of 7 s each aligned by cross-correlation and summed. Example acceptance indicators: 1 kV resolution ≤ 10 nm, 5 kV ≤ 3.5 nm, magnification error ≤ 1%, probe-current stability ≤ 2% over 8 h, EDS Mn Kα resolution ≤ 130 eV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間；依驗收表逐項測試並由雙方簽署；把每項數值、影像與條件存入交接檔案，作為日後效能退化的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min; test every item in the acceptance table and have both parties sign; store every value, image and condition in the handoff file as the baseline for future degradation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 漂移預算：1 nm/min 的漂移在 56 s 的單幀內造成 0.93 nm 的拖影，對 3.2 nm 探針是 29% 的損失。
場發射源的亮度高，所以任何電流下探針都比鎢絲細。
顯示的放大率數字就是校正過的尺度，與工作條件無關。
optionsEn: Drift budget: 1 nm/min over a 56 s frame smears 0.93 nm, a 29% loss on a 3.2 nm probe.
A field-emission source is brighter, so its probe is finer at every current than a tungsten hairpin's.
The displayed magnification number is a calibrated scale independent of operating conditions.
quiz.explanation: 漂移預算：1 nm/min 的漂移在 56 s 的單幀內造成 0.93 nm 的拖影，對 3.2 nm 探針是 29% 的損失；要把拖影壓到探針的 10%（0.32 nm），漂移必須小於 0.34 nm/min，或改用 8 幀各 7 s 的快速掃描並以互相關對齊後疊加。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Drift budget: 1 nm/min over a 56 s frame smears 0.93 nm, a 29% loss on a 3.2 nm probe; to hold the smear to 10% of the probe (0.32 nm) drift must stay below 0.34 nm/min, or use 8 fast frames of 7 s each aligned by cross-correlation and summed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收、漂移與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收測試與操作規範」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance tests and operating procedures” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間；依驗收表逐項測試並由雙方簽署；把每項數值、影像與條件存入交接檔案，作為日後效能退化的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min; test every item in the acceptance table and have both parties sign; store every value, image and condition in the handoff file as the baseline for future degradation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收只在 15 kV、短工作距離下拍一張金顆粒影像便簽收，交機後使用者主要在 1 kV 看高分子，解析度與漂移從未在那個條件驗證，半年後才發現低電壓效能不足但已無合約依據。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance signed on one gold-particle image at 15 kV and short working distance, while the user mainly works at 1 kV on polymers; resolution and drift were never verified under that condition, and when the low-voltage performance proves inadequate six months later there is no contractual basis left.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間；依驗收表逐項測試並由雙方簽署；把每項數值、影像與條件存入交接檔案，作為日後效能退化的基準。
knowledge.textEn: After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min; test every item in the acceptance table and have both parties sign; store every value, image and condition in the handoff file as the baseline for future degradation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收、漂移與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間。
EDS 成分圖的空間解析度和二次電子影像一樣是奈米級。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min.
EDS composition maps have the same nanometre spatial resolution as the secondary-electron image.
quiz.explanation: 樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間；依驗收表逐項測試並由雙方簽署；把每項數值、影像與條件存入交接檔案，作為日後效能退化的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min; test every item in the acceptance table and have both parties sign; store every value, image and condition in the handoff file as the baseline for future degradation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收、漂移與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收測試與操作規範」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance tests and operating procedures” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 驗收只在 15 kV、短工作距離下拍一張金顆粒影像便簽收，交機後使用者主要在 1 kV 看高分子，解析度與漂移從未在那個條件驗證，半年後才發現低電壓效能不足但已無合約依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance signed on one gold-particle image at 15 kV and short working distance, while the user mainly works at 1 kV on polymers; resolution and drift were never verified under that condition, and when the low-voltage performance proves inadequate six months later there is no contractual basis left. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件包含各條件的校正表、場址量測、每月維護項目（光圈清潔、尖端閃熱、法拉第杯校正）、以及針對絕緣與高分子樣品的操作規範。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package holds calibration tables per condition, site measurements, monthly maintenance items (aperture cleaning, tip flashing, Faraday-cup calibration) and operating procedures for insulating and polymer specimens.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「驗收時影像夠清楚就代表所有條件下都達到規格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A clear image at acceptance proves specification is met under all conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 驗收只在 15 kV、短工作距離下拍一張金顆粒影像便簽收，交機後使用者主要在 1 kV 看高分子，解析度與漂移從未在那個條件驗證，半年後才發現低電壓效能不足但已無合約依據。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance signed on one gold-particle image at 15 kV and short working distance, while the user mainly works at 1 kV on polymers; resolution and drift were never verified under that condition, and when the low-voltage performance proves inadequate six months later there is no contractual basis left.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收、漂移與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

驗收只在 15 kV、短工作距離下拍一張金顆粒影像便簽收，交機後使用者主要在 1 kV 看高分子，解析度與漂移從未在那個條件驗證，半年後才發現低電壓效能不足但已無合約依據。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
